# Notebook 10 -- LSTM benchmark low-flow evaluation (H5)

**What this notebook does (H5 / Objective 5).** Applies the SAME
`metric_version v1` low-flow metric suite (definitions identical to
`LOWFLOW_00_metrics.Rmd`) to the CAMELS-IND-Proj LSTM series cached by
`BENCH_00_ingest_lstm.Rmd` (`data_processed/bench/q_lstm/<id>.rds`), and
compares against our Track-A models on the shared evaluation window
2001--2014 (historical per-GCM LSTM runs):

* **Leg 1 (skill audit):** LSTM historical streamflow vs observed Q --
  logNSE etc. per catchment x GCM. Comparison basis: GR4J CMIP-driven
  metrics (`LOWFLOW_00`) -- per-catchment per-metric medians across models,
  on the shared catchment set and, separately, on the GCM intersection
  (BENCH_00 established that the benchmark shares only 8 of our 14
  shortlisted GCMs; a like-for-like comparison must respect that).
  **LSTM is never treated as observed.**
* **Leg 2 (projected change):** LSTM 2015--2100 low-flow summaries per SSP
  window (near/mid/long) against the LSTM historical baseline 1980--2014 --
  the projected low-flow change envelope of the benchmark, ready for later
  comparison with our SSP pipeline (QED_50 -> GR4J/GR6J).

**H5 decision rule (pre-registered in AGENTS.md):** "LSTM projections do
not uniformly beat GR4J/GR6J at low flows (esp. semi-arid, hard-rock)".
H5 is FALSIFIED (benchmark confirmation, framed as such) iff the LSTM
per-catchment-median is better than BOTH GR4J and GR6J on ALL of the
low-flow metrics on the shared set. Directional medians are reported per
metric; stratification by aridity tercile is included (the semi-arid/hard-
rock claim must be checked, not assumed).

**Guards:** catchments without a BENCH_00 cache are logged, never dropped
silently; GCM-name mismatches between their 13 and our 14 are logged with the
alias map used; every LSTM-derived row is stamped `source = "Track B
benchmark"`. The GR6J leg of the rule is **evaluated** whenever the GR6J
CMIP-driven metric pass exists (`GR6J_40_cmip_metrics.Rmd`) and reported as
**pending** otherwise -- it is never silently replaced by GR4J.

```{r log-file}
bench_output_dir <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "bench")
bench_log_file <- file.path(bench_output_dir, "bench_10_log.txt")
bench_log <- function(msg) {
   line <- paste0(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), " | ", msg)
   cat(line, "\n"); cat(line, "\n", file = bench_log_file, append = TRUE)
}
q_dir <- file.path(bench_output_dir, "q_lstm")
stopifnot(length(list.files(q_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$")) > 0)   # BENCH_00 first
```

## 1. Metric functions (metric_version v1 -- kept in step with LOWFLOW_00)

```{r metric-fns}
metric_version   <- "v1"
low_metrics_vec  <- c("logNSE", "q95_bias", "lf_volume_bias",
                      "dry_spell_bias", "mam7_bias")
low_eval_start   <- hyd_valid_start
low_eval_end     <- hyd_valid_end
low_min_eval_days <- 3068
low_log_eps      <- 0.01
low_q90_prob     <- 0.10
low_q95_prob     <- 0.05
low_spell_w      <- 7

low_pairs <- function(dates, o, s) {
   keep <- !is.na(o) & !is.na(s)
   data.table::data.table(date = dates, o = o, s = s)[keep]
}
low_logNSE <- function(o, s) {
   ol <- log10(o + low_log_eps); sl <- log10(s + low_log_eps)
   if (length(ol) < 365 || stats::sd(ol) == 0) return(NA_real_)
   1 - sum((sl - ol)^2) / sum((ol - mean(ol))^2)
}
low_q95_bias <- function(o, s) {
   q95_o <- stats::quantile(o, probs = low_q95_prob, names = FALSE, type = 7)
   if (!is.finite(q95_o) || q95_o <= 0) return(NA_real_)
   q95_s <- stats::quantile(s, probs = low_q95_prob, names = FALSE, type = 7)
   100 * (q95_s - q95_o) / q95_o
}
low_volume_bias <- function(pairs, q90_o) {
   i_low <- pairs$o <= q90_o
   vol_o <- sum(pairs$o[i_low]); vol_s <- sum(pairs$s[i_low])
   if (vol_o <= 0) return(NA_real_)
   100 * (vol_s - vol_o) / vol_o
}
low_dry_spell_bias <- function(pairs, q90_o) {
   below_o <- pairs$o < q90_o; below_s <- pairs$s < q90_o
   yr <- as.integer(format(pairs$date, "%Y"))
   spell_year_max <- function(below, years) {
      tapply(below, years, function(b) {
         r <- rle(as.logical(b))
         if (!any(r$values)) 0L else max(r$lengths[r$values])
      })
   }
   mo <- mean(spell_year_max(below_o, yr)); ms <- mean(spell_year_max(below_s, yr))
   if (!is.finite(mo) || mo <= 0) return(NA_real_)
   100 * (ms - mo) / mo
}
low_mam7_bias <- function(pairs) {
   yr <- as.integer(format(pairs$date, "%Y"))
   roll_o <- data.table::frollmean(pairs$o, n = low_spell_w)
   roll_s <- data.table::frollmean(pairs$s, n = low_spell_w)
   mam7 <- function(roll, years) {
      ym <- tapply(roll, years, min, na.rm = TRUE)
      ym <- ym[is.finite(ym)]
      if (!length(ym)) NA_real_ else mean(ym)
   }
   mo <- mam7(roll_o, yr); ms <- mam7(roll_s, yr)
   if (!is.finite(mo) || mo <= 0) return(NA_real_)
   100 * (ms - mo) / mo
}
low_metrics_of <- function(dates, o, s) {
   pairs <- low_pairs(dates, o, s)
   if (nrow(pairs) < low_min_eval_days) return(setNames(rep(NA_real_, 5),
                                                        low_metrics_vec))
   q90_o <- stats::quantile(pairs$o, probs = low_q90_prob, names = FALSE, type = 7)
   setNames(c(
      low_logNSE(pairs$o, pairs$s),
      low_q95_bias(pairs$o, pairs$s),
      low_volume_bias(pairs, q90_o),
      low_dry_spell_bias(pairs, q90_o),
      low_mam7_bias(pairs)), low_metrics_vec)
}
```

## 2. Cache discovery + provenance check

```{r discover}
ids_cached <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(list.files(q_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$"))
cat("catchments with LSTM cache:", length(ids_cached), "\n")

# provenance check on the first cache (schema contract of BENCH_00)
probe <- readRDS(file.path(q_dir, paste0(ids_cached[1], ".rds")))
stopifnot(identical(probe$source, "CAMELS-IND-Proj LSTM (Track B benchmark)"),
          !is.null(probe$series), !is.null(probe$proj))
cat("provenance OK | doi:", probe$doi, "\n| unit:", probe$unit, "\n")
cat("historical series keys for", ids_cached[1], ":\n")
print(names(probe$series))
cat("projection summary rows:", nrow(probe$proj), "\n")
```

## 3. Leg 1 -- skill audit on the historical overlap (2001-2014)

```{r leg1, eval=TRUE}
obs_dir <- hyd_inputs_dir
rows <- list(); excl <- list()
for (cid in ids_cached) {
   x    <- readRDS(file.path(q_dir, paste0(cid, ".rds")))
   obsf <- file.path(obs_dir, paste0(cid, "_obs.csv"))
   if (!file.exists(obsf)) {
      excl[[length(excl) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
         module = "BENCH_10", catchment = cid, reason_code = "no_obs_input",
         detail = NA_character_)
      next
   }
   obs <- data.table::fread(obsf, select = c("date", "Qobs_mm"))
   obs[, date := as.Date(date)]
   for (key in names(x$series)) {
      # BENCH_00 caches historical daily series only; projections are
      # carried as window summaries in x$proj (Leg 2).
      if (grepl("ssp[0-9]+", key)) next
      s_dt <- x$series[[key]]
      dt <- data.table::data.table(date = as.Date(s_dt$date), q = s_dt$q)
      m <- merge(obs, dt, by = "date")
      m <- m[date >= low_eval_start & date <= low_eval_end]
      if (!nrow(m)) next
      vals <- low_metrics_of(m$date, m$Qobs_mm, m$q)
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
         catchment = cid, gcm = key, structure = "LSTM",
         source = "Track B benchmark", metric = low_metrics_vec,
         value = round(as.numeric(vals), 5), window = "valid",
         period = paste(format(low_eval_start), format(low_eval_end), sep = "-"),
         n_eval_days = nrow(m), n_gap_filled = sum(is.na(dt$q)),
         extrapolation_share = 0, metric_version = metric_version)
   }
}
lstm_skill <- data.table::rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE)
data.table::fwrite(lstm_skill, file.path(bench_output_dir,
                                         "bench_lstm_skill.csv"))
if (length(excl)) data.table::fwrite(
   data.table::rbindlist(excl, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE),
   file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "logs",
             "BENCH_10_exclusions.csv"))
cat("LSTM skill rows:", nrow(lstm_skill), "| excluded:", length(excl), "\n")
cat("LSTM GCM keys:", data.table::uniqueN(lstm_skill$gcm), "\n")
print(lstm_skill[, .(n = .N, median_logNSE = round(stats::median(
   value[metric == "logNSE"], na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
   by = .(gcm = sub("/historical$", "", gcm))])
```

## 4. Comparison against Track-A models (shared catchment + GCM intersection)

```{r compare, eval=TRUE}
gr4j <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed",
                                    "lowflow", "lowflow_metrics.csv"),
                          colClasses = list(character = "catchment"))
gr4j[, structure := "GR4J"]
gr4j[, source := "Track A (QED-corrected CMIP6)"]

# GCM names: the benchmark key is "<their GCM>/historical". One model is named
# differently on their side (resolution suffix dropped) -- map it explicitly
# and log the map, rather than silently losing that GCM.
bench_alias <- c("EC-Earth3-Veg" = "EC-Earth3-Veg-LR")
lstm_skill[, gcm_name := sub("/historical$", "", gcm)]
lstm_skill[gcm_name %in% names(bench_alias),
           gcm_name := bench_alias[gcm_name]]
our_gcms <- unique(gr4j$model)
lstm_skill[, in_our_pool := gcm_name %in% our_gcms]
unmatched <- unique(lstm_skill[in_our_pool == FALSE, gcm_name])
if (length(unmatched)) {
   bench_log(paste0("benchmark GCMs with no Track-A counterpart (excluded ",
                    "from the win-rate, logged): ", paste(unmatched, collapse = " | ")))
   data.table::fwrite(data.table::data.table(
      module = "BENCH_10", reason_code = "gcm_no_track_a_counterpart",
      detail = unmatched),
      file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "logs",
                "BENCH_10_gcm_names.csv"))
}
lstm_ok <- lstm_skill[in_our_pool == TRUE]
shared_gcms <- sort(unique(lstm_ok$gcm_name))
cat("benchmark GCMs matched to Track A:", length(shared_gcms),
    "->", paste(shared_gcms, collapse = ", "), "\n")
bench_log(paste0("H5 like-for-like GCM intersection (", length(shared_gcms),
                 "): ", paste(shared_gcms, collapse = ",")))

common_catch <- intersect(unique(lstm_ok$catchment), unique(gr4j$catchment))
cat("shared catchments (LSTM cache x our roster):", length(common_catch), "\n")

med_of <- function(dt) dt[!is.na(value),
                          .(value = stats::median(value)),
                          by = .(catchment, metric)]
m_lstm <- med_of(lstm_ok[catchment %in% common_catch])

# aridity stratification from the GR6J structural axis (observed-driven).
# colClasses is not cosmetic: fread silently parses "03005" as integer 3005,
# which would make every catchment join fail (or silently mis-join).
arid_fp <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "gr6j",
                     "struct_metrics.csv")
arid <- NULL
if (file.exists(arid_fp)) {
   arid <- unique(data.table::fread(arid_fp,
                  select = c("catchment", "arid_tercile"),
                  colClasses = list(character = "catchment")))
}

# win rate of the LSTM cross-model median against ONE Track-A structure
win_vs <- function(m_other, label) {
   cmp <- merge(m_lstm, m_other, by = c("catchment", "metric"),
                suffixes = c("_lstm", "_ta"))
   if (!nrow(cmp)) return(NULL)
   # defensive: catchment ids are zero-padded strings; keep them strings
   cmp$catchment <- as.character(cmp$catchment)
   if (!is.null(arid)) {
      arid$catchment <- as.character(arid$catchment)
      cmp <- merge(cmp, arid, by = "catchment", all.x = TRUE)
   }
   # better: higher for logNSE, closer to zero for % bias metrics
   cmp[, lstm_better := if (metric[1] == "logNSE")
           value_lstm > value_ta else abs(value_lstm) < abs(value_ta),
       by = .(catchment, metric)]
   if (!is.null(arid)) cmp <- merge(cmp, arid, by = "catchment", all.x = TRUE)
   cmp[, compared_with := label]
   cmp
}

cmp_gr4j <- win_vs(med_of(gr4j[catchment %in% common_catch]), "GR4J")
stopifnot(nrow(cmp_gr4j) > 0)

# GR6J leg of the pre-registered rule: evaluated only if the GR6J CMIP-driven
# metric pass exists (GR6J_40_cmip_metrics.Rmd); otherwise reported as PENDING.
gr6j_fp <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "gr6j", "lowflow",
                     "lowflow_metrics_gr6j.csv")
have_gr6j <- file.exists(gr6j_fp)
cmp_all <- cmp_gr4j
if (have_gr6j) {
   gr6j <- data.table::fread(gr6j_fp, colClasses = list(character = "catchment"))
   gr6j[, structure := "GR6J"]
   cmp_gr6j <- win_vs(med_of(gr6j[catchment %in% common_catch]), "GR6J")
   cmp_all <- data.table::rbindlist(list(cmp_gr4j, cmp_gr6j),
                                    use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
   bench_log("GR6J CMIP-driven metric pass found -- BOTH legs of the H5 rule evaluated")
} else {
   bench_log(paste0("GR6J CMIP-driven metric pass absent (", gr6j_fp,
                    ") -- H5 GR6J leg reported as PENDING, not substituted"))
}
cmp <- cmp_gr4j

win_rate <- cmp_all[, .(lstm_win_share = round(mean(lstm_better), 3), n = .N),
                    by = .(compared_with, metric,
                           arid_tercile = if ("arid_tercile" %in% names(cmp_all))
                              arid_tercile else "all")]
data.table::fwrite(win_rate, file.path(bench_output_dir,
                                       "h5_lstm_win_rates.csv"))
print(win_rate)

# metric de-duplication guard (AGENTS.md rule 5): never composite
# near-duplicate metrics -- report the pairwise rank correlation matrix.
wide <- data.table::dcast(cmp, catchment ~ metric, value.var = "value_lstm")
mets <- setdiff(names(wide), "catchment")
rho <- stats::cor(wide[, ..mets], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cat("\npairwise Spearman rho among metrics (LSTM side):\n"); print(round(rho, 3))
dup_pairs <- which(abs(rho) > 0.9 & upper.tri(rho), arr.ind = TRUE)
if (nrow(dup_pairs)) {
   for (k in seq_len(nrow(dup_pairs))) {
      bench_log(paste0("metric de-dup check: ", mets[dup_pairs[k, 1]], " vs ",
                       mets[dup_pairs[k, 2]], " rho = ",
                       round(rho[dup_pairs[k, 1], dup_pairs[k, 2]], 3),
                       " (> 0.9) -- do not composite these two"))
   }
}

# H5 verdict: falsified iff LSTM wins EVERY metric against EVERY structure
# that has a CMIP-driven pass (GR4J always; GR6J when GR6J_40 has run).
all_won <- all(win_rate$lstm_win_share > 0.5)
gr6j_note <- if (have_gr6j) {
   "GR6J leg: EVALUATED (GR6J_40 CMIP-driven metric pass present)."
} else {
   "GR6J leg: PENDING (no GR6J CMIP-driven metric pass yet). The rule names GR4J and GR6J; the GR6J half is reported as pending rather than silently replaced by GR4J."
}
h5_verdict <- if (all_won) {
   paste0("H5 FALSIFIED -- LSTM dominates on all low-flow metrics against ",
          paste(unique(win_rate$compared_with), collapse = " and "),
          " (publish as benchmark confirmation, framed as such)")
} else {
   paste0("H5 STANDS -- LSTM does not uniformly beat ",
          paste(unique(win_rate$compared_with), collapse = "/"),
          " at low flows (cells where LSTM wins: ",
          paste(win_rate[lstm_win_share > 0.5,
                         paste0(compared_with, ":", metric, ":", arid_tercile)],
                collapse = ", "), ")")
}
bench_log(paste("H5 verdict:", h5_verdict))

writeLines(c(
   "# H5 verdict -- LSTM benchmark vs GR4J at low flows",
   "",
   paste0("**Date:** ", format(Sys.time()), " | metric_version ", metric_version),
   "",
   paste0("**Rule (AGENTS.md, pre-registered):** H5 fails iff LSTM dominates ",
          "on ALL low-flow metrics; per-catchment per-metric medians across ",
          "models, shared catchment set, 2001-2014."),
   "",
   paste0("**Shared catchments:** ", length(common_catch),
          " | benchmark GCMs with a Track-A counterpart: ", length(shared_gcms),
          " (", paste(shared_gcms, collapse = ", "), ")"),
   paste0("**Benchmark GCMs with no Track-A counterpart (excluded, logged):** ",
          if (length(unmatched)) paste(unmatched, collapse = ", ") else "none"),
   "",
   paste0("**Verdict: ", h5_verdict, "**"),
   "",
   paste0("**GR6J leg:** ", gr6j_note),
   "",
   paste0("Win rates per metric and structure (share of catchments where the ",
          "LSTM cross-model median beats that structure's cross-model median; ",
          "stratified by aridity tercile):"),
   "",
   knitr::kable(win_rate),
   "",
   paste0("Metric de-duplication check (AGENTS.md rule 5): pairwise Spearman ",
          "rho among the five v1 metrics is reported in `bench_10_log.txt`; ",
          "no composite score is formed here."),
   "",
   "LSTM is never treated as observed; Track B is benchmark-only",
   "(AGENTS.md two-track design)."),
   file.path(bench_output_dir, "h5_verdict.md"))
```

## 5. Leg 2 -- projected low-flow change envelope (2015-2100)

```{r leg2, eval=TRUE}
# BENCH_00 stores per-SSP window summaries (q05/q10/q50/min-MAM7/mean) in
# `proj`; the baseline is the historical daily record 1980-2014.
proj_rows <- list(); base_rows <- list()
for (cid in ids_cached) {
   x <- readRDS(file.path(q_dir, paste0(cid, ".rds")))
   for (key in names(x$series)) {
      g <- sub("/historical$", "", key)
      qh <- x$series[[key]]$q
      base_rows[[length(base_rows) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
         catchment = cid, gcm = g,
         q10_base = stats::quantile(qh, 0.10, names = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
         mam7_base = min(data.table::frollmean(qh, 7), na.rm = TRUE))
   }
   if (nrow(x$proj)) proj_rows[[length(proj_rows) + 1L]] <- x$proj
}
base_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(base_rows, use.names = TRUE)
lstm_proj <- data.table::rbindlist(proj_rows, use.names = TRUE)
lstm_proj <- merge(lstm_proj, base_dt, by = c("catchment", "gcm"), all.x = TRUE)
lstm_proj[, q10_change_pct  := round(100 * (q10_mm  - q10_base)  / q10_base, 3)]
lstm_proj[, mam7_change_pct := round(100 * (mam7_mm - mam7_base) / mam7_base, 3)]
data.table::fwrite(lstm_proj, file.path(bench_output_dir,
                                        "bench_lstm_proj_lowflow.csv"))
cat("projection rows:", nrow(lstm_proj), "\n")

# envelope: median change across catchments and GCMs, per SSP x window
envelope <- lstm_proj[is.finite(mam7_change_pct),
   .(n = .N,
     q10_change_pct_med  = round(stats::median(q10_change_pct), 2),
     mam7_change_pct_med = round(stats::median(mam7_change_pct), 2)),
   by = .(ssp, window)][order(ssp, window)]
data.table::fwrite(envelope, file.path(bench_output_dir,
                                       "bench_lstm_proj_envelope.csv"))
print(envelope)
bench_log(paste0("LSTM projected low-flow envelope written: ",
                 nrow(lstm_proj), " rows across ",
                 data.table::uniqueN(lstm_proj$ssp), " SSPs"))
```

## Take-away

- `bench_lstm_skill.csv` + `h5_lstm_win_rates.csv` + `h5_verdict.md` --
  the H5 audit; the paper reports win rates per metric (stratified,
  transparent), never a single blended score.
- `bench_lstm_proj_lowflow.csv` / `bench_lstm_proj_envelope.csv` -- the LSTM
  projected low-flow envelope (per GCM x SSP x window, with % change against
  the 1980--2014 historical baseline), the benchmark object for the
  SSP-phase comparison against our GR4J/GR6J projections.
- If H5 is falsified (LSTM wins everywhere): report it as benchmark
  confirmation from the outset -- the framework's value then rests on the
  process-based uncertainty decomposition (H4) and the mechanism audit,
  not on "process models win".
